subject.title: fix: skip setup-only channel plugins in outbound resolution and drain pending deliveries on qqbot reconnect

question: Should the operation-aware resolver precedence and automatic account-scoped QQBot reconnect drain become the canonical behavior for existing plugin registries?
rationale: Code review supports the implementation, but repository policy treats plugin selection and automatic queued-message retry as compatibility- and message-delivery-sensitive contracts that require owner intent.

options.title: Approve canonical behavior
options.body: Land the exact-head implementation with its tested operation-specific selection and account-scoped reconnect retry policy.

options.title: Narrow reconnect replay
options.body: Accept the resolver fix but split or further constrain automatic QQBot queue draining before landing.

recommendation.title: Approve canonical behavior
recommendation.body: Land the exact-head implementation with its tested operation-specific selection and account-scoped reconnect retry policy.
